summary: Tested 4 new features: AI Topic & Keyword Research, Blog Sitemap.xml, Weekly Blog Digest, and Clean URLs for static pages. All 20 backend tests passed. All frontend UI elements verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: AI Topic Research (POST /api/blog/research-topics) properly calls OpenAI GPT-4o-mini and returns structured topic suggestions with keywords
Sitemap.xml (GET /api/blog/sitemap.xml) returns valid XML with all static pages using clean URLs and published blog posts
Blog Digest (POST /api/blog/send-digest) correctly queries recent blogs and sends emails via Resend API
Clean URLs work via craco devServer middleware mapping /, /about, /services, etc. to static HTML files
Static HTML files use absolute asset paths (/website/style.css) and clean URL navigation links
Blog routes /industrial-hiring-insights and /career-insights properly route to React components
seed_data_creation: No test data created - used existing blog posts
